_comment: The dependency graph for toolcrib's generation pipeline -- generated files (component-manifest.json, CORE.md, src/index.ts, security-advisories.json) and the real source each one depends on. Read via scripts/lib/buildGraph.js, matched via scripts/lib/graphEngine.js, driven from the CLI via scripts/build-engine.js. Each input's 'reason' is a manually-synced parallel to the real fs calls in scripts/lib/extract.js -- robust to changes within the trees already named here, not to a genuinely new tree outside them. See AGENTS.md's generation-pipeline sections for the full picture; this file is the machine-readable version of that same information, not a duplicate authored independently.

inputs.reason: generateComponents()'s prop-type resolution cross-scans the entire src/ tree via listSourceFiles(SRC) (extract.js:562-568), not just src/components/ -- a component's prop can reference an interface declared anywhere under src/.
same generateComponents()/extract.js cross-scan as manifest -- generate-docs.js calls the same functions
generateBarrelExports() (extract.js:880-901) scans this dir's own top-level JSDoc tags only -- no cross-file resolution, unlike manifest/docs
